Seven Corp on behalf of Tony and Marks Direct  

Overview: 

Tony & Mark's is a proudly family-owned South Australian business that has been providing premium fresh produce, gourmet foods, and exceptional customer service for over 46 years. With multiple retail locations across Adelaide, we are committed to sourcing the highest quality local and international products while supporting growers, suppliers, and the communities we serve. Our team is passionate about delivering an outstanding shopping experience built on quality, freshness, and service excellence.

We are currently seeking a Fruit and Veg Inspector to join the team! you will be responsible for maintaining the quality, safety, and compliance of fresh produce through inspections, food safety monitoring, and quality assurance processes. This is a full-time ongoing position, working 38 hours per week based in Cavan, SA.

Main tasks:

-	Inspect incoming fruit and vegetables for quality, freshness, grade, size, colour, and condition
-	Develop and monitor QC procedures (Freshcare SC2, HACCP, HARPS)
-	Measure and record cold chain temperatures; report deviations
-	Test samples and make accept/reject decisions
-	Ensure hygiene standards in storage, packing, dispatch, and transport
-	Identify and manage non-conforming products; coordinate corrective actions
-	Evaluate supplier performance and escalate non-conformances
-	Maintain inspection logs, temperature records, and non-conformance reports
-	Advise purchasing and warehouse teams on stock condition and availability
-	Conduct internal audits of food safety procedures
-	Liaise with suppliers, transport contractors, and internal stakeholders
-	Stay current with Australian food safety regulations and produce standards

Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum of relevant Diploma, plus minimum 1 year’s relevant work experience in the last 5 years.
-	3 years’ relevant work experience may substitute the formal qualification.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	1 year's experience in fresh produce inspection/QC (wholesale, not retail)
-	Freshcare SC2 knowledge
-	HARPS familiarity
-	Cold chain management experience
-	HACCP knowledge
-	Strong documentation and record-keeping
-	Availability from 3:00 AM
-	Able to work in cold storage (0°C–4°C)


Annual salary will be between $75,000.00 to $85,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Specialised Industrial Solutions (SIS) is a locally owned and operated industrial services company based in Mount Isa, servicing mining and industrial clients throughout Queensland and the Northern Territory.

As a Business Intelligence Developer, you will become the bridge between the technical world of data and the strategic needs of our clients. This is not your average developer or analyst role as you'll need to be a data expert, have an eye for beautiful dashboards and ultimately, be a champion of user-friendly insights.


Responsibilities:
Build clear and compelling dashboards for a diverse range of clientele to transform raw data into actionable insights.
Collate, transform and analyse data from varying sources.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate complex business problems into technical solutions.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable SQL code as fluency in the language of data is a must.
Work with cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure to design and implement data solutions.
Apply architecture best practices to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and reliable.
Understand and implement integrations between cloud services and on-premise or third-party applications.
Stay ahead of the curve and explore new technologies and methodologies to keep our data game strong.


The right person will have:
Proficiency in SQL, data warehousing concepts, and ETL processes.
Demonstrable BI Dev / BA experience - understanding of key business concepts and the ability to translate them into technical solutions.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or others.
Experience with automating ETL processes, reports, or data workflows to optimize and scale data operations.
Basic understanding of architecture best practices, including scalability, security, and reliability.
Exceptional communication skills which include being about to clearly explain complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to identify data challenges and develop effective solutions.
A passion for data and a desire to make an impact – you're excited to leverage data to drive business success.
Power BI experience essential.
Based in Sydney.


Behavioural:
Bring a positive, enthusiastic, "can-do" attitude to the office each day and help build-on the strong culture at Kandui Group.
Ability to meet deadlines and balance competing pressures.
Have an interest in understanding and adding value to the business.
Rigorous attention to detail.
Ability to work in [and enjoy] a team environment.
Strong appetite to come into the office everyday.
